_timing: No narration yet. Each beat is the larger of the time it needs to finish animating and the time it takes to read, plus a 22-frame hold. This is a floor, not considered pacing — measure a real read and switch this topic to voiceCuts.

beats.note: Nupedia was founded by Jimmy Wales, funded by Bomis, with Larry Sanger as editor in chief and a seven step review process.

beats.context: Finished the whole review process by the end of Nupedia, with about 150 more in progress.

beats.name: Larry Sanger
beats.role: Proposed the wiki idea on the Nupedia mailing list and, on 11 January 2001, suggested the name Wikipedia.

beats.note: It was meant to let articles be drafted together before entering Nupedia's peer review.

beats.text: The side project outgrew the main one.
beats.note: English Wikipedia passed 200,000 articles in January 2004. Nupedia's server crashed on 26 September 2003, the date given as its end.

beats.text: The careful project finished 24 articles. The side project did the rest.
